environment: github-actions-runner (ubuntu-24.04), plus a headless Chromium context
policy: Read-only reachability record. A page listed here is NOT a price. Only a two-sided, first-party prematch series line or a published official rating may produce a number, and the ladder in scripts/originate.py decides which one is used.
conclusion: No new automated two-sided price source was found for the low-tier fixtures. EGamersWorld refuses the runner even in Chromium, HLTV refuses the runner, Oddspedia is deleted and BetExplorer/OddsPortal did not answer with a usable page. bo3.gg answered and remains the only relay of a named bookmaker, but it prices only a subset of fixtures.

sources.name: EGamersWorld CS2 match listing
sources.note: Cloudflare challenge to the runner (requests). A person can load the page; its listing odds are unverified and can contradict its own match page — see egamersworld-observation.json. Page title at the runner: 'Just a moment...'.

sources.name: EGamersWorld match page (Bushido Wildcats vs ex-6666)
sources.note: Cloudflare challenge to the runner (requests). Read by hand for the observation record; most low-tier pages print a 1.8/1.8 placeholder. Page title at the runner: 'Just a moment...'.

sources.name: BetExplorer CS2
sources.note: No CS2 page at this address (HTTP 404). Not used.

sources.name: Oddspedia CS2
sources.note: Permanently deleted (HTTP 410); the previous sweep recorded the same status. Page title at the runner: 'The resource you have requested has been permanently deleted'.

sources.name: OddsPortal CS2
sources.note: HTTP 503 from the runner. No price extracted.

sources.name: HLTV match listing
sources.note: Cloudflare challenge to the automated runner. HLTV publishes identity, rankings and a fan vote, not a two-sided prematch price, so it is never an odds input. Page title at the runner: 'Just a moment...'.

sources.name: bo3.gg public match API (relayed bookmaker quotes)
sources.note: Public match API answered. It relays a named bookmaker quote (Thunderpick) for a subset of upcoming fixtures; the ladder already consumes it through the relay rung. A fixture without that block has no relayed price.

sources.name: Hotspawn lobby (inventory only)
sources.note: The authoritative scheduled inventory, independent of any price. Page title at the runner: "Pick'ems Lobby | Hotspawn Play".

sources.name: EGamersWorld CS2 listing — headless Chromium
sources.note: A real Chromium context (UTC timezone, desktop user agent) still received the security-verification interstitial, so automation cannot use EGamersWorld as a live price feed. Manual, dated captures remain the only reviewed use of that site.

sources.name: bo3.gg relay coverage on the same observation
sources.note: 100 upcoming fixtures read; 23 carried a named bookmaker quote block. Only those can produce a relayed line.

observation.title: EGamersWorld listing vs its own match page — human read
observation.summary: A reader loaded EGamersWorld on 2026-10-22T08:10:00Z for 5 of the fixtures that carry a research-model pick. The site prints its 1.8/1.8 placeholder for 4 of them, and for one fixture its listing pair contradicts its own match page, which shows the placeholder and no bookmaker-average sentence. No listing number was promoted to a price.
